goal: Web host と Workspace Electron を同じ設定・fleet/provider 契約を実装する対等な clients/ui host にし、非client deployable servicesと専用共有基盤を独立 services Go moduleへ flag-day 移行する。
approach: clients/config の servers.json v2 を両 host の起動時 immutable snapshot とし、credential-free fleet projectionを共通化する。Web hostはclients/web-host独立module、非client service群はgithub.com/takezoh/agent-grid/services独立moduleとし、top-level ownershipをservices/, clients/, protocol/, contracts/, docs/, deploy/, scripts/, test-harness/へ固定する。

in_scope: src/uihost と src/cmd/uihost を clients/web-host 独立 Go moduleへ移動し web-host と命名する
servers.json v2、host-neutral fleet/provider、credential boundary、typed partial failureを Web host と Workspace に共通化する
src module contentsをservices/へflag-day移動する
clients/desktop-configをclients/configへflag-day renameし全client host共通のlanguage-neutral schema/fixtures ownerにする
active consumersをtop-level services/, clients/, protocol/, contracts/, docs/, deploy/, scripts/, test-harness/ layoutへ更新する
既存 Web static/CSP/security header/same-origin WS/retryable upstream semantics を server-qualified routeで保持する
out_of_scope: completed/abandoned change package本文を現在実装へ同期すること
clients/web-host から services moduleへの require、replace、internal import
repository-root Go moduleまたはflat Go package tree
runtime config reload、credential の browser/renderer projection、legacy unqualified proxy routeの互換 shim

requirements.statement: The system MUST expose one host-neutral, credential-free, server-qualified fleet/provider contract to clients/ui regardless of whether the host is Web host or Workspace Electron.
If a host provides a fleet, the system MUST NOT branch on browser versus Electron, collapse the fleet to one server, or synthesize an implicit server.
requirements.rationale: 旧browser one-server adapterを判別可能に禁止する。

requirements.statement: When either client host starts, the system MUST load and validate servers.json schema version 2 exactly once and publish one immutable version-consistent snapshot or a typed startup failure.
If bearer authentication is configured, the system MUST NOT expose bearer material to clients/ui, browser JavaScript, Electron renderer, logs, or host projections.
requirements.rationale: credential ownerをhost trust boundaryへ固定する。

requirements.statement: clients/web-host MUST remain an independently buildable nested Go module with no require, replace, internal import, or source import from the services module.

While Web host serves clients/ui, the system MUST preserve embedded static delivery, CSP and security headers, same-origin WebSocket checks, credentialed upstream routing, and typed retryable upstream-not-ready behavior on server-qualified routes.
requirements.rationale: 移動でbrowser-visible security/transport semanticsを失わない。

requirements.statement: When the services-module flag day is applied, the system MUST move src module metadata and cmd, host, server, platform, orchestrator, internal, gorules, protocolsim, and .golangci.yml together into services/, use module github.com/takezoh/agent-grid/services, update every active consumer, and leave no src wrapper.
requirements.rationale: nonclient services ownershipを一意にする。

requirements.statement: If repository references are migrated, the system MUST NOT rewrite completed or abandoned change history merely to mirror the current source layout, and MUST NOT copy tracked empty src/.claude placeholders over repository-local host configuration.
requirements.rationale: immutable historyとuser/environment configを保護する。

non_functional_requirements.measurement: module gates and tracked active-reference audit

adrs.title: Host-neutral configured fleet provider
adrs.context: The accepted fleet boundary confined credentials correctly but privileged Electron multi-server and browser one-server behavior.
adrs.decision: Supersede the browser one-server portion: every UI host loads servers.json v2, owns credentialed routing, and exposes the same credential-free server-qualified provider; host differences are transport only. Use immutable startup snapshots.
consequences: Web host becomes a fleet router

status_provenance.rationale: User accepted every proposed ADR after the host-neutral fleet design and revised repository layout were explained.

adrs.title: Independent Web host nested Go module
adrs.context: uihost currently imports parent platform/lib/tlsdev, which conflicts with an independent clients/web-host module.
adrs.decision: Move command, host package, embed assets and tests into module github.com/takezoh/agent-grid/clients/web-host; own the small TLS serving implementation under that module and forbid all parent-module edges.
consequences: TLS helper code exists on each side of the module boundary
root go test does not cover the nested module

alternatives.why_not: Creates a vague box solely to avoid a small cohesive host responsibility.

status_provenance.rationale: User accepted every proposed ADR after the host-neutral fleet design and revised repository layout were explained.

adrs.title: Server-qualified Web host transport continuity
adrs.context: Removing one-server behavior requires a qualified route, while CSP, headers, same-origin WS, auth confinement and retry semantics must remain.
adrs.decision: Expose credential-free /host/config and same-origin /host/servers/{serverId}/api/... and /host/servers/{serverId}/ws; resolve serverId in the immutable snapshot, inject auth in Web host, strip the host prefix upstream, reject redirects, and remove legacy unqualified /api and /ws routes in the flag day.
consequences: Browser-visible route shape changes with UI in one flag day
legacy route shims do not survive

alternatives.option: Keep /api and /ws as an implicit default
alternatives.why_not: Reintroduces the forbidden single-server special case.
Leaks trust and origin policy into shared UI.

status_provenance.rationale: User accepted every proposed ADR after the host-neutral fleet design and revised repository layout were explained.

adrs.title: Independent services Go module flag day
adrs.context: The repository needs a named owner for nonclient deployable services and their dedicated shared infrastructure without mixing Go client hosts into that boundary.
adrs.decision: Move src/go.mod, src/go.sum, cmd, host, server, platform, orchestrator, internal, gorules, protocolsim, and .golangci.yml into services/ as module github.com/takezoh/agent-grid/services in one flag day. Rename clients/desktop-config to clients/config. Keep top-level source ownership under services/, clients/, protocol/, contracts/, docs/, deploy/, scripts/, and test-harness/ with no src wrapper or repository-root Go module.
consequences: services and client hosts have separate module owners

alternatives.option: Repository-root Go module and flat packages
alternatives.why_not: Rejected by the user because it lacks the explicit services ownership boundary.

alternatives.option: Incremental dual roots or src wrapper

status_provenance.rationale: User accepted every proposed ADR after the root-module proposal was replaced by the services-module design.

decision_dispositions.rationale: Independent module and owned TLS boundary are fixed.
Accepted credential isolation is generalized while browser one-server is superseded.
The flag day is retained but its target is the explicit independent services module; repository-root Go module is rejected.
Qualified routes preserve the required observable semantics without a one-server default.

resolved_issues.resolution: Grounded the plan in three applicable accepted ADRs and explicitly superseded only the browser one-server clause.
Grounding now points to clients/workspace and its real config/provider seams.
Credential-bearing snapshot/routing stays in each host; UI projection is credential-free.
Selected immutable startup snapshot and exhaustive determinate/unknown/inconclusive config outcomes with precedence.
Web host owns its TLS implementation and has GOWORK=off/no-parent-edge gates.
Fixed services module target, top-level owners, active consumer classes, clients/config rename, no src wrapper, and completed-history exemption.
Fixed stable operator startup codes and credential-free per-server UI outcomes with retry ownership.
